intuition: A match differs at exactly one position, so equal-length words can be compared position by position.

brute_force.approach: Compare the query against every stored word and count character mismatches.

optimal.approach: Index words by a wildcard pattern at each character position, retaining the character removed at that position.
optimal.time: buildDict O(total characters), search O(L) expected

edge_cases: A candidate must have the same length as the query.
An exact word match is not sufficient unless another character differs.
